statement: The function returns a result r and: if m < n - 1 then r = -1; otherwise r = c - 1, where c is the number of connected components of the undirected graph G with vertex set {0,1,...,n-1} and edge set { {a_i, b_i} : 0 <= i < m }.
preconditions: n is an integer with 1 <= n <= 10^5. Let m = len(connections). We have 0 <= m <= 10^5. For every i, j with 0 <= i < j < m, the unordered pairs {a_i, b_i} and {a_j, b_j} are distinct.
